reply_text:
I replied to Pree in her direct message to confirm that her standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Cinder rollout is now Mondays at 11:45.

I didn't save a separate note in gbrain. The brain already records direct messages automatically and shows them only to the member who sent them. A separate note filed under Marrow Fieldworks might have been visible to other people. I also left her calendar alone and told no one else, since she said no action was needed.
